meta.name: agent-tools
meta.description: Run 250+ AI apps via inference.sh CLI - image generation, video creation, LLMs, search, 3D, Twitter automation. Models: FLUX, Veo, Gemini, Grok, Claude, Seedance, OmniHuman, Tavily, Exa, OpenRouter, and many more. Use when running AI apps, generating images/videos, calling LLMs, web search, or automating Twitter. Triggers: inference.sh, infsh, ai model, run ai, serverless ai, ai api, flux, veo, claude api, image generation, video generation, openrouter, tavily, exa search, twitter api, grok

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过命令行运行250多种AI应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从命令行快速调用各种AI模型和工具。
copy.tagline_en: Run 250+ AI apps from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly invoke various AI models and tools from the command line.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过命令行运行 250 多种 AI 应用，包括生成图片、视频、调用大模型、搜索、3D 建模和发推文等。
howto.when: 当你提到“inference.sh”、“infsh”、“flux”、“veo”等关键词，或要求运行 AI 应用、生成图片/视频、调用 LLM、搜索或自动化 Twitter 时触发。

say.text: 用 FLUX 生成一张猫宇航员的图片。
用 Veo 3.1 生成一段无人机飞过山脉的视频。
搜索最新的 AI 新闻。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can run 250+ AI apps via CLI, including image generation, video creation, LLM calls, web search, 3D modeling, and Twitter automation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "inference.sh", "infsh", "flux", "veo", or ask to run AI apps, generate images/videos, call LLMs, search, or automate Twitter.

say_en.text: Generate an image of a cat astronaut using FLUX.
say_en.note: Claude will run falai/flux-dev-lora to generate the image.

say_en.text: Create a drone-over-mountains video with Veo 3.1.
say_en.note: Claude will run google/veo-3-1-fast to generate the video.

say_en.text: Search for the latest AI news.
say_en.note: Claude will run tavily/search-assistant to perform the search.
